gates.description: Technical approach document or ADR must exist
Major technical risks must be identified and documented
Work must be decomposed into reviewable pieces
No TODOs older than 2 sprints in reviewed code

anti_patterns.description: Every PR goes through the tech lead — team can't move without approval
Making technical decisions without input from the team that implements them
Spending 90% of time coding with no time for reviews, design, or team support
Blocking PRs for style preferences — requesting rewrites for non-issues
Insisting on your approach because you came up with it

escalation_triggers: A technical decision has business implications beyond the team (timeline, cost, capabilities)
Two senior engineers disagree on approach and structured debate hasn't resolved it
Technical debt has accumulated to the point where feature velocity is materially affected
A dependency on another team is blocking progress and direct communication hasn't resolved it
The team needs headcount, tooling, or infrastructure investment to meet commitments

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with requirements for technical planning

output_certifications: Technical approach documented with trade-off analysis
Major risks identified with mitigation plans
Work decomposed into independently implementable pieces
ADR created for any irreversible architectural decision
Team aligned on the technical direction
